about_the_game:
With the purchase, you automatically receive in-game credits for the same value!
Step into the most unpredictable, hilarious, and fast-paced VR party game around! Toilet Toss throws you—quite literally—into head-to-head battles where precision, chaos, and strategy collide. Whether you're here to crush your friends or just fling random objects into a porcelain throne, one thing's for sure: fun is guaranteed.

🎯 Aim. Toss. Dominate.
Take part in lightning-fast 1v1 matches where every second counts. Hone your throwing skills, perfect your angles, and hit bonus targets to activate insane obstacles that can completely mess up your opponent's game. Outsmart, outthrow, and outflush them!

😂 Party-Ready Mayhem
With its vibrant visuals, outrageous interactions, and endlessly satisfying mechanics, Toilet Toss is built for both competitive chaos and casual party fun. Whether it's a quick session or a full-blown tournament night, you'll be shouting, laughing, and demanding rematches every round.

🚽 Toss Like a Champ
Throw with style and confidence as you master your timing and accuracy. Climb the leaderboard, show off your skills, and become a true Toilet Toss champion.

🎁 Unlock All the Best Objects
Discover and unlock a ridiculous variety of throwable items — from plungers and toothbrushes to rubber ducks and other unexpected surprises. Each object brings its own flavor to the game and helps keep the chaos fresh.

🌎 Immersive & Ridiculously Fun
Jump into this quirky VR experience that blends colorful environments with competitive energy. Designed from the ground up for VR, the controls feel natural, the chaos feels earned, and the gameplay? Addictive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or Oculus PC
  • Additional Notes: Quest compatible, so it should run on any VR Ready computer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Hilarious VR battles where toilets are the battleground. Toss, score, and flush your way to victory!
